say:2:1011311001:1.text: Hmmm... Not bad. Let's go with this look for the new prosthetics.
say:2:1011311001:1.source_cn: 嗯……新义肢的外形先暂时这样好了，马马虎虎。

say:3:1011311002:0.text: Incredible. Even with such basic materials, they take form simply through cutting and carving...
say:3:1011311002:0.source_cn: 难以置信。明明是那么原始的材料，竟然只靠切割雕刻就能成型……

say:4:1011311003:0.text: Yep, I've done it over a hundred times while working on the prototype.
say:4:1011311003:0.source_cn: 嗯哼，因为在研究雏形时，我已经做过上百次啦。

say:5:1011311004:0.text: Besides, look! I handcrafted this crafting table, and the wood carvings of the deer spirit behind the house. They're all random creations from my fun experiments.
say:5:1011311004:0.source_cn: 除此之外，你们看！这架制作台是我一笔一划设计的，还有屋...

say:6:1011311005:1.text: I... never thought I'd see such exquisite craftsmanship in the Dark Forest.
say:6:1011311005:1.source_cn: 我……从没想到，能在薄暮丛林看到如此精湛的技艺。

say:7:1011311006:1.text: Korin, this is nothing compared to what you did for me. There's more impressive stuff coming up!
say:7:1011311006:1.source_cn: 科林大叔，比起你的救命之恩，这只是一点小手艺而已！后面...

say:8:1011311007:1.text: The processing part is done up to this point. The next steps are a bit tricky, and we'll need to gather some more materials...
say:8:1011311007:1.source_cn: 现在义肢还没有完成，光说加工的话，截止到这一步就可以了...

say:12:1011311009:1.text: Master Dahnie has just returned and is waiting for you at the Sage's Court. Eironn and Lyca have already headed there.
say:12:1011311009:1.source_cn: 我来知会各位一声：达赫妮贤者刚刚回来啦，正在贤者庭等你...
say:12:1011311009:1.male: Master Dahnie has just returned and is waiting for you at the Sage's Court. Eironn and Lyca have already headed there.
say:12:1011311009:1.female: Master Dahnie has just returned and is waiting for you at the Sage's Court. Eironn and Lyca have already headed there.

say:13:1011311010:1.text: Granny's back so soon! I need to finish working on these prosthetic arms. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't you go meet her first?
say:13:1011311010:1.source_cn: 婆婆这么快就回来啦？我还要准备对义肢做后续处理，<st...
say:13:1011311010:1.male: Granny's back so soon! I need to finish working on these prosthetic arms. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't you go meet her first?
say:13:1011311010:1.female: Granny's back so soon! I need to finish working on these prosthetic arms. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't you go meet her first?

say:14:1011311011:1.text: I'm not interested in those complicated and dull grown-up matters! They mess with my creative thinking!
say:14:1011311011:1.source_cn: 大人那些又复杂又无聊的事，我可不想听！会干扰创造思维！
